lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Missiles gone, every one. They're swatting them out of the sky.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Point defence. They learned it. From us, maybe.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Sparrow's leaking air. I can hold. I can hold— Captain, permission to panic?

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: ...Denied. Nanda asked me that, too. Hold on, Teo.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Li said see you at Meridian.
